title: LegalWorld: A Life-Cycle Interactive Environment for Legal Agents
title_zh: LegalWorld：面向法律智能体的全生命周期交互环境
abstract_en: Civil litigation is inherently a life-cycle process: what a lawyer drafts on day one constrains what unfolds at trial months later. Yet existing legal benchmarks evaluate isolated subtasks, and prior legal-agent simulators reinitialize each scenario from shared ground truth, leaving cross-stage causal dependencies unmodeled. We present LegalWorld, a life-cycle interactive environment that models Chinese civil litigation as a causally connected state chain of five stages (seven sub-scenarios), grounded in 75,309 paired Chinese civil judgments. We pair it with reusable infrastructure (local memory, global case memory, a Skill/Tool library) that keeps each dispute consistent across its full life cycle. Building on this environment, we construct LongJud-Bench to evaluate agent capability across all five connected stages. 18,992 ratings from 217 legal-background evaluators confirm that LegalWorld trajectories are procedurally faithful and role-consistent; and a capability-level cross-model evaluation reveals sharp divergences that aggregate scores cannot expose, with no single backbone leading across consultation, drafting, and courtroom advocacy. Detailed resources will be released publicly.
abstract_zh: 民事诉讼天然是一个全生命周期过程：律师在第一天起草的材料，会约束数月后庭审中的发展。然而，现有法律基准多评测孤立子任务，既有法律智能体模拟器也常从共享真值重新初始化每个场景，无法建模跨阶段因果依赖。本文提出 LegalWorld，一个面向中国民事诉讼的全生命周期交互环境，将诉讼过程建模为包含五个阶段、七个子场景的因果连接状态链，并基于 75,309 对中国民事判决书构建。LegalWorld 配套提供可复用基础设施，包括 local memory、global case memory 以及 Skill/Tool library，以保证同一纠纷在完整生命周期中的一致性。在此基础上，作者构建 LongJud-Bench，用于评估智能体在五个相互连接阶段中的能力。来自 217 名具备法律背景评估者的 18,992 条评分表明，LegalWorld 生成轨迹在程序上可信且角色一致；跨模型能力层级评估进一步揭示了总分难以呈现的显著差异，没有任何单一 backbone 能在咨询、文书起草和法庭辩论等能力上全面领先。相关资源将公开发布。
key_points_zh: 提出 LegalWorld，将中国民事诉讼建模为五阶段、七子场景的因果连接状态链，强调跨阶段决策对后续程序的影响。
基于 75,309 对中国民事判决书构建环境，并通过 local memory、global case memory、Skill/Tool library 维持案件全流程一致性。
构建 LongJud-Bench，评估法律智能体在咨询、文书起草、庭审等相互依赖阶段中的综合能力。
217 名法律背景评估者给出 18,992 条评分，验证 LegalWorld 轨迹具备较好的程序真实性与角色一致性。
跨模型评测显示，不同 backbone 在不同法律能力上差异明显，单一总分会掩盖咨询、起草和庭辩能力的细粒度差别。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong domain simulator with memory and tool infrastructure, but its main contribution is a legal-agent environment rather than general harness architecture.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一个带记忆和工具基础设施的强领域模拟环境，但主要贡献仍是法律智能体环境而非通用框架架构。
